item.tib: zhi rgyas lag len dri med shel gyi me longs
item.coloph: spral sku rig 'dzin chen po yis/ char gcod me dpung dgu sgril 'di/ dus mtha'i rnam 'byor bdag la gnang / dkar chag yi ger bkod pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong bstan srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
